{{Quote|You ''live'' on this disgusting planet?|[[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]] to [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]|<ref name="SWJS" />}}
'''Lok''' {{Pronounced|lɒk|file=LokPronounced-JediStarfighter.flac}} was a barren and dusty [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Beware of dangerous beasts, pirates, confusing mazes and a very large and active volcano.|A [[Lok Marathon]] race coordinator|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
Lok was a planet located in the [[Karthakk system]],<ref name="Lok" /> in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[File:Loklandscape.png|thumb|left|222px|Landscape of Lok.]]
It was a harsh and inhospitable world. Jagged mountain ranges, long expanses of baked desert, desolate flats, dangerous [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] pools and lava pits were commonly found on the planet.<ref name="Lok" /> Lok was also the home of several hostile creatures, including the massive [[Kimogila]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
===Old Republic era===
{{Quote|Nym is the most feared pirate in the Maramere system. He routed the Trade Federation from Lok and its neighboring planets right around the start of the Clone Wars, and he's maintained complete control over the spacelanes in this region ever since.|[[Vana Sage]], about [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]|<ref name="SWG:MVS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet Vana Sage|Lok}}</ref>}}
Lok was one of the first planets in the Karthakk system to be colonized. It was originally home to outlaws who saw the world as a potential staging ground for raids into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Lok" />

[[File:TF_super_SWS.jpg|thumb|left|222px|Trade Federation forces landing on Lok.]]
The pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] lived on Lok as a child. He became a powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] during years leading up to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and founded a pirate group known as the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> They attacked ships coming and leaving the planet until the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] decided to [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|invade]] the planet after one such pirate raid in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="SWS">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref>

The [[Occupation of Karthakk|occupation]] of Lok lasted ten years. During that time, the Trade Federation used Nym's captured [[Nym's Base|base]] as a staging ground for their raids in the Karthakk system. The Lok Revenants finally [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|reclaimed]] Lok during the first days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], thanks to the support of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and the [[Mere Resistance]].<ref name="SWJS" />

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|There's nobody with more power on Lok. And except for Jabba the Hutt, he's probably the most powerful alien in the Outer Rim.|Vana Sage, about Nym|<ref name="SWG:MVS" />}}
In the aftermath of the Trade Federation defeat in the Karthakk system, the Lok Revenants became the main power of Lok and Nym ruled the planet as a [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]].<ref name="Insider65" /> A city named [[Nym's Stronghold]] was built around Nym's old base and served as planetary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for the entire planet.<ref name="SWG" /> A [[Lok Station|space station]] was also built in Lok orbit to control starships wishing to land at the Nym's Stronghold spaceport.<ref name="SCKS">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66849&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Karthakk System}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] competition known as the [[Lok Marathon]] was held on the planet.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

[[File:IG-88_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|222px|The [[Battle of Nym's Factory Compound]].]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually claimed Lok and established a military presence on the planet.<ref name="Insider65" /> An [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|outpost]] was built there, as part of a plan to extend Imperial control over less developed worlds. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this base was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]].<ref name="SWG" /> However, although the planet was technically under Imperial control, Nym remained Lok's true ruler. Nym was more friendly with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] than with the Empire but since General Otto did not try to interfere with the Lok Revenants, Nym decided to not defy the Empire directly.<ref name="Insider65" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Nym's Factory Compound|Nym's droid factory]] on Lok was the site of a large [[Battle of Nym's Factory Compound|battle]] between spacers affiliated with the Lok Revenants and [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88's]] [[Droid Revolution|revolutionary]] [[IG-88's Droid Army|droid army]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA" />

[[File:LokFlag.png|150px|thumb|Flag of Lok]]

===Post-Galactic Civil War===
Around [[137 ABY]], Lok was home to a cantina<ref name="Legacy2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref> called [[Brogar's Safe House and Cantina]]<ref name="LECG" /> which served as a safe-house for various fugitives. It was there that [[Cade Skywalker]] captured gambler [[Naxy Screeger]] and Jedi [[Hosk Trey'lis]].<ref name="Legacy2" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], three moons could be seen from the surface of Lok.<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] expansion pack in [[2004]], the three moons could yet again be seen from space.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> This is in contradiction with the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' released in [[2009]], which claims Lok only had two moons. As the Campaign Guide is the more recent source regarding the number of Lok's moons, this article assumes that it is [[Star Wars Legends|''Legends'']] canon, and that the appearance of a third moon in ''Star Wars Galaxies'' is erroneous.<ref name="LECG" />
